column1: # preferred_present_stems.tsv -- infinitive <TAB> present stem. The stem the
# Present stem card field shows when hazm 0.12.1 verbs.dat (MIT) lists another
# line for the same infinitive first: nevesht#navard (line 639) before
# forukht#forush (496), bud#ast (143, the copula) before bud#bash (144), and
# kasht#kar (523, kashtan "to plant") before kosht#kosh (524, koshtan "to
# kill"). Each row is one of the infinitive's own verbs.dat lines; words.dat
# holds no conjugated forms, so the pick cannot be measured from the pack.
